title: How to Run Multiple Claude Code Agents on the Same Xcode Project
summary: Amarildo Lucas reproduces two agents reporting successful builds while one overwrites the other’s installed app and inherits its saved data on a shared Simulator. An iOS team can assign a Simulator UDID and DerivedData path to each worktree, then verify the installed build number and process after overlapping runs, rather than treating compilation as proof of isolation.
takeaway: Pin every build, install, launch, and test to its assigned Simulator; check installed build identity and process continuity after concurrent agents finish.
